condition: UTI matches regex ^[A-Z0-9]{18,52}$
message: UTI must be 18 to 52 alphanumeric characters (upper case letters and digits only), in line with the CPMI-IOSCO UTI technical guidance and ISO 23897.

condition: UPI matches regex ^[A-Z0-9]{12}$
message: UPI must be a 12-character alphanumeric code issued by the Derivatives Service Bureau (DSB) in accordance with ISO 4914.

condition: Counterparty1LEI matches regex ^[A-Z0-9]{18}[0-9]{2}$ AND passes ISO 17442 mod-97 checksum
message: Counterparty 1 LEI must be a valid 20-character LEI code with a correct ISO 17442 check digit checksum.

condition: Counterparty2LEI matches regex ^[A-Z0-9]{18}[0-9]{2}$ AND passes ISO 17442 mod-97 checksum, OR Counterparty2IdentifierType = 'NATURAL_PERSON'
message: Counterparty 2 identifier must be a valid 20-character LEI with correct checksum, unless the counterparty is a natural person not acting in a business capacity, in which case the natural-person identifier scheme must be used instead.

condition: NotionalAmount is numeric, > 0, with at most 25 digits and 5 decimal places
message: Notional amount must be a positive number with no more than 25 digits in total and no more than 5 digits following the decimal separator.

condition: Currency matches regex ^[A-Z]{3}$ AND Currency IN ISO4217ActiveCurrencyList
message: Currency must be a valid, currently active 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

condition: MaturityDate matches ISO 8601 date format YYYY-MM-DD AND is a valid calendar date
message: Maturity date must be a valid calendar date expressed in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

condition: ReportingTimestamp matches ISO 8601 UTC datetime format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
message: Reporting timestamp must be a valid UTC date-time expressed in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ).

condition: ActionType IN {'NEWT','MODI','CORR','EROR','REVI','VALU','POSC','TERM','ETRM','COMP'}
message: Action type must be one of the permitted values defined in the EMIR Refit ITS: NEWT, MODI, CORR, EROR, REVI, VALU, POSC, TERM, ETRM or COMP.

condition: AssetClass IN {'CO','CR','CU','EQ','IR','OT'}
message: Asset class must be one of the permitted values: CO (Commodity), CR (Credit), CU (Currency), EQ (Equity), IR (Interest Rate) or OT (Other).

condition: UTI IS NOT NULL for all ActionType values
message: UTI is a mandatory field and must be populated on every report, regardless of action type.

condition: UPI IS NOT NULL WHEN ActionType IN {'NEWT','MODI','CORR','REVI'} AND ContractType requires product identification
message: UPI must be populated for new, modified, corrected or revised reports of derivatives in scope of UPI identification requirements.

condition: Counterparty1LEI IS NOT NULL
message: Counterparty 1 LEI is a mandatory field and must not be blank.

condition: Counterparty2LEI IS NOT NULL OR (Counterparty2IdentifierType = 'NATURAL_PERSON' AND Counterparty2NaturalPersonId IS NOT NULL)
message: An identifier for counterparty 2 is mandatory: either a valid LEI, or a natural-person identifier when counterparty 2 is not acting in a business capacity.

condition: NotionalAmount IS NOT NULL WHEN NotionalScheduleFlag = false
message: Notional amount is mandatory for derivatives with a fixed notional; where the notional varies over the life of the contract, a notional schedule must be reported instead.

condition: Currency IS NOT NULL
message: Notional currency is a mandatory field and must not be blank.

condition: MaturityDate IS NOT NULL WHEN ContractType <> 'PERPETUAL'
message: Maturity date is mandatory for all derivatives with a defined end date; perpetual contracts must instead flag ContractType as PERPETUAL.

condition: ReportingTimestamp IS NOT NULL
message: Reporting timestamp is a mandatory field and must not be blank.

condition: ActionType IS NOT NULL
message: Action type is a mandatory field and must be populated on every submitted report.

condition: AssetClass IS NOT NULL
message: Asset class is a mandatory field and must not be blank.

condition: UTI at t = UTI at t-1 WHEN ActionType IN {'MODI','VALU','POSC','COMP'} for the same derivative
message: UTI must remain unchanged across the lifecycle of a derivative; modification, valuation, position and compression reports must reference the UTI assigned at execution.

condition: UPI EXISTS AND status = 'ACTIVE' in DSB UPI reference database AS OF ExecutionTimestamp
message: UPI must correspond to an active product code registered in the DSB UPI reference database as of the trade execution date.

condition: Counterparty1LEI.status IN {'ISSUED','LAPSED'} in GLEIF database AS OF ReportingTimestamp
message: Counterparty 1 LEI must be registered in the GLEIF database with a status of ISSUED or LAPSED; DUPLICATE, RETIRED or MERGED records are not acceptable.

condition: Counterparty2LEI.status IN {'ISSUED','LAPSED'} in GLEIF database AS OF ReportingTimestamp
message: Counterparty 2 LEI must be registered in the GLEIF database with a status of ISSUED or LAPSED; DUPLICATE, RETIRED or MERGED records are not acceptable.

condition: NotionalAmount.currency = Currency field value for every reported leg
message: The currency denomination of the notional amount must match the value reported in the Currency field for every leg of the derivative.

condition: Currency IN ISO4217ActiveCurrencyList AS OF ReportingTimestamp
message: Currency must be an ISO 4217 code that is active as of the reporting date; withdrawn or historic currency codes are not accepted.

condition: MaturityDate >= EffectiveDate AND MaturityDate >= ExecutionTimestamp.date
message: Maturity date must not be earlier than the effective date or the execution date of the derivative.

condition: ReportingTimestamp >= ExecutionTimestamp
message: Reporting timestamp must not be earlier than the execution timestamp of the derivative.

condition: IF ActionType IN {'MODI','CORR','EROR','REVI','VALU','POSC','ETRM'} THEN a prior report with ActionType = 'NEWT' AND matching UTI MUST EXIST in trade repository history
message: Modification, correction, error, revival, valuation, position or early-termination reports must reference a UTI for which an original NEWT report already exists in the trade repository.

condition: AssetClass consistent with product taxonomy resolved from UPI reference data
message: Asset class must be consistent with the product classification derived from the reported UPI; mismatches between asset class and UPI taxonomy are not permitted.

condition: COUNT(UTI) = 1 WHERE ActionType = 'NEWT' AND Counterparty1LEI = generating entity, evaluated across full reporting history
message: A UTI generated by the reporting entity must not duplicate any UTI previously generated by that entity for a different derivative.

condition: UPI product taxonomy matches ContractType and AssetClass reported on the same report
message: The product taxonomy associated with the reported UPI must be consistent with the ContractType and AssetClass values reported on the same report.

condition: Counterparty1LEI = SubmittingEntityLEI OR Counterparty1LEI = ReportingCounterpartyLEI's delegated reporting mandate entity
message: Counterparty 1 LEI must correspond either to the report-submitting entity or to the counterparty on whose behalf reporting has been delegated.

condition: Counterparty2LEI <> Counterparty1LEI UNLESS IntragroupFlag = true
message: Counterparty 2 identifier must differ from Counterparty 1 LEI unless the report is flagged as an intragroup transaction.

condition: NotionalAmount > 0 AND consistent with Quantity * PriceNotation WHERE both fields populated
message: Notional amount must be strictly greater than zero and, where quantity and price notation are also reported, must be consistent with their product.

condition: Currency = DeliverableCurrency WHEN SettlementCurrency IS NULL
message: Notional currency must be consistent with the deliverable currency of the contract where no separate settlement currency is reported.

condition: MaturityDate <= ExecutionTimestamp.date + 100 years
message: Maturity date more than 100 years after the execution date is considered implausible and must be reviewed before submission.

condition: ReportingTimestamp <= ExecutionTimestamp + 1 working day
message: Report must be submitted no later than the working day following the conclusion, modification or termination of the derivative, in accordance with Article 9 of EMIR.

condition: IF ActionType = 'COMP' THEN LinkedUTIs IS NOT NULL AND COUNT(LinkedUTIs) >= 2
message: Compression reports (ActionType = COMP) must reference at least two prior UTIs that were compressed into the resulting position.

condition: IF AssetClass = 'CU' THEN DeliverableCurrency IS NOT NULL AND SettlementCurrency IS NOT NULL
message: Where asset class is Currency (CU), both the deliverable currency and settlement currency legs must be populated.

condition: LEFT(UTI, 20) <> UTIGeneratingEntityLEI
message: UTI prefix does not match the LEI of the UTI-generating entity; confirm the identifier follows the CPMI-IOSCO UTI technical guidance naming convention.

condition: UPI last updated in DSB reference data > 180 days ago
message: UPI reference data has not been refreshed in the DSB database for over 180 days; recommend re-validating the product code for recent corporate action updates.

condition: Counterparty1LEI.registrationRenewalDate < ReportingTimestamp + 30 days
message: Counterparty 1 LEI registration is due for renewal within 30 days; recommend confirming renewal to avoid the LEI lapsing to inactive status.

condition: Counterparty2LEI.status = 'LAPSED'
message: Counterparty 2 LEI has a LAPSED registration status in GLEIF; the counterparty should be reminded to renew its registration.

condition: NotionalAmount > 10,000,000,000 (in reporting currency equivalent)
message: Notional amount exceeds 10 billion in reporting currency equivalent; recommend manual plausibility review before submission.

condition: Currency IN DeprecatedOrRedenominatedCurrencyList
message: Currency code is deprecated or has been redenominated; confirm the correct successor ISO 4217 code has been used.

condition: MaturityDate falls on a non-business day per applicable settlement calendar
message: Maturity date falls on a non-business day for the relevant settlement calendar; confirm the correct business day convention has been applied.

condition: ReportingTimestamp within 2 hours of ExecutionTimestamp + 1 working day deadline
message: Report is being submitted close to the T+1 reporting deadline; recommend reviewing submission timing to reduce the risk of late reporting.

condition: COUNT(ActionType IN {'CORR','EROR'}) FOR SAME UTI > 3 WITHIN 30 days
message: More than three correction or error reports have been submitted for the same UTI within 30 days; recommend reviewing the upstream data quality process.

condition: AssetClass = 'OT'
message: Asset class reported as Other (OT); recommend reviewing the product classification to confirm a more specific asset class code is not applicable.
